description:
Filament.Renderer.render/3 returns an 8-tuple:

  {walked, hooks, effects, fibers, evt_handlers, cap_handlers, evt_kinds, cap_kinds}

Callers unpack it positionally (octo_pi_tui2/render_pipeline.ex:89–104 calls this out as 'order-dependent, fragile'). Adding a 9th return — for example a per-render min_periodic_ms surfaced from a future use_periodic hook — means changing every caller.

Replace with:

  defmodule Filament.RenderResult do
    defstruct [
      :walked,
      :hooks,
      :effects,
      :fibers,
      :event_handlers,
      :capture_handlers,
      :event_handler_kinds,
      :capture_handler_kinds
    ]
  end

Callers pattern-match the fields they care about; new fields can be added without breaking existing consumers.

Why: surfaced during opi-4x0 (tui2 cleanup) audit. opi-4x0.20 wants to plumb periodic-tick min-interval back through the renderer instead of through the process dictionary side channel; doing so cleanly requires a structural return shape.

How to apply: extend Filament.Renderer.render/3 to return %RenderResult{}; downstream consumers (octo_pi_tui2, any external user) migrate one site each.
title: %Filament.RenderResult{} struct replacing the 8-tuple return from Renderer.render/3
